守密人你好：
       弥萨格大学校务处将于8月6日16:10(UTC+8) 进行校内设施修复，更新完成后您将得到通知，重新进入游戏。对于更新可能给大家带来的不便，我们会准备一份补给物资以示歉意。祝大家调查顺利！ 
  
【补给物资】
在线维护补偿：银芯×50
  
【领取条件】
领取时间截至2026年8月20日23:59。请记得及时前往邮箱领取补给物资哦。

【更新内容】

一、故事

【秘典书库】
● 「留声机」中新增了专辑「征伐永不止歇」。
● 「广播剧」中新增了广播剧「原则」。

【本地化】
● 英语
    ○ 优化了唤醒体「蚀灭·萝坦」的部分技能故事翻译。
    ○ 优化了界域「原初·混沌」中特殊钥令机制相关的文本翻译。
● 韩语
    ○ 优化了唤醒体「蚀灭·萝坦」的技能描述翻译。
    ○ 优化了部分「维度影像」和「命轮」的名称措辞。
    ○ 优化了翻译措辞，「테이션의 형상」名称现已统一替换为「윤회의 상」。
● 日语
    ○ 更新了唤醒体「蚀灭·萝坦」的日语配音，并修复了此前配音的翻译错误，以更符合人物设定。
● 综合
    ○ 优化了日语、俄语、印尼语、泰语、越南语设置下，唤醒体「蚀灭·萝坦」的相关文本。感谢志愿者们的帮助！
二、战斗
● 调整了唤醒体「达芙戴尔」狂气爆发「原质之海」。现在置入超维空间的「千面幻象」视为触发维度跃迁，会触发相关效果，在「奇点·超维」界域中会获得「奇点信标」。

三、问题修复

【活动】
    ○ 修复了切换活动页面时，活动「利维坦的游戏」的界面动画可能会显示错误的问题。
    ○ 修复了活动「利维坦的游戏」中，在「斗兽场祭祀台」兑换命轮「不灭的饥骨」时可能会出现异常动画的问题。

【故事】
● 本地化
    ○ 英语
        ■ 修复了唤醒体「阿格里帕」的启灵「灰烬与头颅」描述错误的问题。
    ○ 韩语
        ■ 修复了「特遣纪录」中，「蚀灭·萝坦」篇章「直至鲸天陨落」剧情中的文字错误。
        ■ 修复了部分技能文本中可能会出现乱码的问题。
        ■ 修复了「匕首」被错误翻译为「短ガー」的问题。
    ○ 德语
        ■ 修复了唤醒体「沙耶」的名字拼写错误的问题。
    ○ 西班牙语
        ■ 修复了钥令「罗网轮转」的描述中数字显示异常的问题。
    ○ 综合
        ■ 修复了多个语言设置下，部分探索事件中的造物名称和技能名称显示异常的问题。
        ■ 修复了在部分语言设置下，活动「如果一切如常·复刻」可能出现文本重叠、文本不全、字色错误的问题。
        ■ 修复了在部分语言设置下，「教程」、「派遣」、「弥萨格商店」界面可能出现文本不全的问题。

【战斗】
● 通用
    ○ 修复了超维界域中界域精通效果描述错误的问题，现在会进行预计算确保获得「灵感」概率与预计算一致。
    ○ 修复了状态「临时强化」和「奇点·超维」界域中「奇点信标」描述错误的问题，调整为固定力量和触腕伤害提高、固定护盾、固定生命回复的最终效果提高，实际效果不变。
    ○ 修复了「奇点·超维」界域中，通过「维度穿梭」以外的方式将卡牌置入超维空间时，也会获得「奇点信标」的问题。
    ○ 修复了拥有「超距」效果的卡牌因「折跃」刻印的效果进入超维空间时，取出后算力消耗未能降低的问题。
● 唤醒体
    ○ 混沌界域
        ■ 修复了唤醒体「蚀灭·萝坦」在某些情况下将卡牌「蚀灭」还原后，手牌中指令卡顺序错误的问题。
        ■ 修复了唤醒体「蚀灭·萝坦」的「巨剑·鲸落」会被「渐渐石化」变化为「石头」的问题。
        ■ 修复了拥有唤醒体「蚀灭·萝坦」的增益卡「巨剑·鲸落」时，钥令「纯白初遇」、技能「同伴的力量」、狂气爆发「照彻渊海的引航」会额外抽取 1 张卡牌的问题。
        ■ 修复了唤醒体「蚀灭·萝坦」天赋描述中，关于「获得银钥能量」的描述中「获得」字样重复的问题。
        ■ 修复了唤醒体「蚀灭·萝坦」携带「梦游仙境」时，视为超限爆发的狂气爆发力量倍率效果仍为普通狂气爆发倍率，且启灵为 0 时会显示启灵 3 文本效果的问题。
        ■ 修复了唤醒体「哈姆林」狂气爆发的力量偷取效果未能享受「繁育·血肉」加成的问题。
        ■ 修复了唤醒体「24」的灵知觉醒「恍然如我」升级描述错误的问题，修复后为：在混沌界域中提高「最终伤害」而非「基础伤害」。
        ■ 修复了唤醒体「塔薇」出战时，若卡组中拥有症状卡「谵妄」，有概率在战斗中卡死的问题。
        ■ 修复了唤醒体「塔薇」获得「长刃·陨」后，无法因打出「打击」而降低算力消耗的问题。
    ○ 深海界域
        ■ 修复了唤醒体「墨菲」狂气爆发「虚妄继承者」释放后进入超维回合时，受到伤害增加献祭的效果会额外增加 1 回合的问题。
        ■ 修复了唤醒体「弥利亚姆」最终法则有时会无法获得「神国幻影」的问题。
    ○ 超维界域
        ■ 修复了唤醒体「汀克特」灵知觉醒「界外之音」赋予的额外效果在置入超维空间后会被移除的问题。
        ■ 修复了唤醒体「卡茜亚」启灵 2「障眼法」中，「抽到症状或状态卡时，对随机目标造成伤害」的效果未能生效的问题。
    ○ 命轮
        ■ 修复了命轮「枉蹙眉」在血肉界域中实际获得的胚胎融合低于显示值的问题。
    ○ 密契
        ■ 修复了密契「光合祭礼」、「生机榨取」、「甜蜜蛞蝓」、「少女之蛹」、「四月礼赞」在「编队」中未正确显示「队伍唯一」且战斗中「队伍唯一」限制实际未正常生效的问题。
        ■ 修复了密契「再衍化」回合结束获得的狂气，未能享受唤醒体「狂气获取加成」的问题。
        ■ 修复了密契「入药之梦」可能因其他战斗开始时效果插入结算，导致无法复制对应卡牌的问题。
● 关卡
    ○ 修复了在「溯梦」模式中游玩「调查行动」第一部 9-7「拉伊·刺骨之视」时，仍然错误地播放大厅背景音乐的问题。
    ○ 修复了在「调查行动」第一部 2-12「少女的眼泪」关卡中装备重复命轮后，可能会导致后续无法进入 2-15「寂静的坍塌」的问题。
    ○ 修复了调查中查看「刻印」效果后，无法通过点击右下方空白处关闭卡牌词缀说明弹窗的问题。
    ○ 修复了敌人「阿吉达哈卡」、「勒耳纳恩」的技能「献祭」错误地享受了自身「疯狂」加成的问题。
    ○ 修复了敌人「护灯尊者」、「食尸鬼护卫」、「食尸鬼卫队长」、「殉道者」死亡后，其召唤的敌人仍然存活的问题。
    ○ 修复了造物「受祝·行道之骸」无法清除负面状态「腐朽」的问题。
    ○ 修复了「星辰篇」造物「维度影像·雷娅」获取的力量值为固定值 8 点，而非随「物象研究深度」变化的问题。
    ○ 修复了「星辰篇」造物「维度影像·24」使 24 获得的暴击率和暴击伤害错误展示在属性面板的问题。
    ○ 修复了「星辰篇」造物「莱茵德纸草书」、「普特尼晨报」效果重置时机错误的问题，正确时机应为我方回合开始时而非回合结束后。
    ○ 修复了「星辰篇」造物「镭射颌骨」在战斗外描述错误显示为 0 的问题。
    ○ 修复了「星辰篇」规则「算力满盈」的生效描述，由「打出指令卡后移除其本回合内算力消耗降低效果」调整为打出「卡牌」后移除，和实际效果一致。

● 相位对弈
    ○ 修复了唤醒体「塔薇」的狂气爆发「万物归一」造成的爆发封锁会受到伤害提升和降低效果影响的问题。
    ○ 修复了命轮「安息之吻」在传递溢出伤害时，会再次享受装备者伤害提升类效果加成的问题。

【综合】
● 通用
    ○ 修复了「学籍档案」、「教程」界面中，部分词缀点开详情后会回弹导致无法查看的问题。
● 唤醒
    ○ 修复了从角色活动唤醒「蚀域冥刃」界面跳转至「蚀灭·萝坦」的唤醒体详情时会出现异常灰块的问题。
● 学期课题
    ○ 修复了重复打开「学期课题」时可能会出现道具资源丢失的问题。
● 物资
    ○ 尝试修复了某些情况下「获得物资」弹窗未正常显示的问题。

**V2.5.3.3 Online Maintenance Announcement**

Dear Keeper,
The Mythag Administration Office will conduct campus facility maintenance on  August 6, 2026 at 16:10(UTC+8) . You will be notified once the update is complete and you can re-enter the game. As an apology for any inconvenience caused by the update, we will provide a supply package. Wishing everyone a successful investigation!
   
[Compensation]
Online Maintenance Compensation: Silver×50
   
[Claim Conditions]
The claiming time ends on August 20, 2026 at 23:59. Please remember to go to your mailox in time to claim the supply materials.
   
[Update Content]

I. Story

[Library]
● A new album, "Conquest Never Ends," has been added to the "Phonograph."
● A new Radio Drama, "Principle," has been added to "Radio Drama."

[Localization]
● English
○ Optimized the skill story translations for the Awakener "Lotan: Cetarchon".
○ Optimized the text translation related to the special Posse mechanics in the Realm "Primordia: Chaos".
● Korean
○ Optimized the skill description translation for the Awakener "Deadly Duel·Lotan".
○ Optimized the wording of some "Dimensional Image" and "Wheel of Destiny" names.
○ Optimized translation wording; the name "테이션의 형상" has been uniformly replaced with "윤회의 상."
● Japanese
○ Updated the Japanese voice acting for Awakener "Lotan: Cetarchon" and fixed previous translation errors in the voice lines to better align with the character's lore.
● General
○ Optimized the related text for the Awakener "Deadly Duel·Lotan" in Japanese, Russian, Indonesian, Thai, and Vietnamese settings. Thanks to the volunteers for their help!

II. Combat
● Adjusted the Awakener "Daphdale's" Exalt "Sea of Primordial Essence." The "Thousand Mirage" placed into Ultra Space is now considered to trigger a Dimensional Leap, activating related Effects, and will obtain a "Singularity Beacon" in the "Singularity: Ultra" Realm.

3. Bug Fixes

[Event]
○ Fixed an issue where the UI animation of the event "Leviathan's Game" might display incorrectly when switching event pages.
○ Fixed an issue in the event "Leviathan's Game" where an abnormal animation could occur when redeeming the Wheel of Destiny "Undying Hungerbone" at the "Arena Altar."

[Story]
● Localization
○ English
■ Fixed an issue where the Enlighten "Ashes and Skulls" description for Awakener "Agrippa" was incorrect.
○ Korean
■ Fixed text errors in the "Till the Cetus Falls" Story of the "Lotan: Cetarchon" chapter in "Special Ops".
■ Fixed an issue where garbled text could appear in certain skill descriptions.
■ Fixed an issue where "Dagger" was incorrectly translated as "Shortガー".
○ German
■ Fixed a typo in the name of the Awakener "Saya".
○ Spanish
■ Fixed an issue where numbers were displaying incorrectly in the description of the Posse "Orbis Fatum."
○ General
■ Fixed an issue where Relic names and skill names displayed incorrectly in certain exploration events under multiple language settings.
■ Fixed an issue in certain language settings where the event "If Life Was As Usual: Rerun" might display overlapping text, incomplete text, or incorrect text color.
■ Fixed an issue where the "Tutorial", "Assignment", and "Mythag Shop" interfaces might display incomplete text under certain language settings.

[Combat]
● General
○ Fixed an issue where the Realm Mastery Effect description in Ultra Realm was incorrect; pre-calculation is now performed to ensure the probability of gaining "Insight" is consistent with the pre-calculation.
○ Fixed an issue where the description of "Singularity Beacon" in the "Temporary Enhance" State and "Singularity: Ultra" Realm was incorrect. The description has been updated to reflect the final Effect Boost of fixed STR & Tentacle DMG Boost, fixed Shield, and fixed HP Healing. The actual effect remains unchanged.
○ Fixed an issue in the "Singularity: Ultra" Realm where placing a Card into Ultra Space through methods other than "Dimension Shuttle" would also grant "Singularity Beacon".
○ Fixed an issue where Cards with the "Quasar" Effect that entered Ultra Space due to the Effect of the "Warp" Orison did not have their Arithmetica Cost reduced after being retrieved.
● Awakener
○ Chaos Realm
■ Fixed an issue where the Awakener "Lotan: Cetarchon" would cause the Command Card order in Hand to be incorrect after restoring the Card "Deadly Duel" in certain situations.
■ Fixed an issue where the "Great Blade: Whalefall" of the Awakener "Lotan: Cetarchon" could be transformed into "Stone" by "Gradually Petrify."
■ Fixed an issue where, when holding the buff Card "Great Blade: Whalefall" with the Awakener "Lotan: Cetarchon", the Posse "Encounter in Pure White", the Skill "Power of Friendship", and the Aliemus Exalt "To Sail the Sundered Tides" would each draw 1 extra Card.
■ Fixed an issue in the Awakener "Lotan: Cetarchon" Talent description where the word "gain" was repeated in the description regarding "gaining Keyflare."

■ Fixed an issue where, when the Awakener "Lotan: Cetarchon" carried "Lily in Wonderland", the STR multiplier Effect of an Over-Exaltation-treated Exalt remained at the normal Exalt multiplier, and when Enlighten was 0, the Enlighten 3 text Effect would still be displayed.
■ Fixed an issue where the STR Steal Effect of Awakener "Hameln"'s Exalt did not benefit from the "Propagation: Caro" bonus.
■ Fixed an issue where the Rouse "Am I or Am I Not?" Upgrade description for Awakener "24" was incorrect. After the fix, it now reads: Increases "Final DMG" instead of "Base DMG" in the Chaos Realm.
■ Fixed an issue where, when the Awakener "Tawil" was deployed, having the Symptom Card "Delirium" in the deck could occasionally cause the game to freeze during combat.
■ Fixed an issue where the Awakener "Tawil" was unable to reduce Arithmetica Cost by playing "Strike" after obtaining "Long Blade: Perish".
○ Aequor Realm
■ Fixed an issue where, after Awakener "Murphy" unleashes Exalt "Delusion's Heir" and enters an Ultra Round, the Effect of increasing Sacrifice by receiving Damage would grant an extra 1 round.
■ Fixed an issue where the Awakener "Miryam" could sometimes fail to obtain "Divine Realm's Illusion" via Absolute Axiom.
○ Ultra Realm
■ Fixed an issue where the extra Effect granted by Awakener "Tinct"'s Rouse "Voices from Beyond" would be removed after being placed into Ultra Space.
■ Fixed an issue where the Effect "When drawing a Symptom or State Card, deal Damage to a random target" in Awakener "Casiah"'s Enlighten 2 "Veil of Illusion" was not activating properly.
○ Wheel of Destiny
■ Fixed an issue where the Wheel of Destiny "Vain Regrets" was granting fewer Embryo Meldings than displayed in the Caro Realm.

○ Covenant
■ Fixed an issue where the Covenants "Photosynthesis Rite", "Life Drain", "Sweet Slug", "Chrysalis of the Maiden", and "April Tribute" did not correctly display "Team Unique" in the "Lineup", and the "Team Unique" restriction was not properly taking effect in battle.
■ Fixed an issue where the Aliemus gained at the end of the Covenant "Re-evolution" turn was not benefiting from the Awakener's "Aliemus Acquisition Bonus."
■ Fixed an issue where the Covenant "Dream of Medicine" could fail to copy the corresponding Card due to other combat Start Effects being inserted into the resolution.
● Stage
○ Fixed an issue where the lobby background music would still incorrectly play while playing Investigation Part 1 9-7 "Rye·Gaze of Scathe" in Remembrance mode.
○ Fixed an issue in Investigation Part 1, Stage 2-12 "A Girl's Tears" where equipping duplicate Wheels of Destiny could prevent players from entering Stage 2-15 "Silent Collapse."
○ Fixed an issue where, after viewing the "Orison" Effect during an investigation, the Card Affix description popup could not be closed by clicking on the blank area in the lower right.
○ Fixed an issue where the enemies "Azhdaha" and "Lernaean" had their skill "Sacrifice" incorrectly benefiting from their own "Madness" bonus.

○ Fixed an issue where enemies summoned by "Luminary", "Ghoul Guard", "Ghoul Guard Captain", and "Martyr" remained alive after their death.
○ Fixed an issue where the Relic "Blessed: Pathwalker's Remains" could not remove the negative State "Decay".
○ Fixed an issue where the STR value obtained from the "Astral Reign" Relic "Dimensional Image·Leigh" was a fixed value of 8, instead of scaling with "Esoteric Research".
○ Fixed an issue where the Relic "Dimensional Image·24" from "Astral Reign" caused the Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG gained by 24 to be incorrectly displayed in the attribute panel.
○ Fixed an issue where the Effects of the "Astral Reign" Relics "Rhind Papyrus" and "Putney Morning Post" were resetting at the wrong time. The correct timing should be at the Start of our turn, not after the turn ends.
○ Fixed an issue where the Relic "Radium Jawbone" from "Astral Reign" incorrectly displayed 0 in its out-of-combat description.
○ Fixed the activation description of the "Astral Reign" rule "Arithmetica Overflow," adjusting it from "removes the Arithmetica Cost reduction Effect for Command Cards played this turn" to removing it after playing a "Card," consistent with the actual Effect.
● Traphase
○ Fixed an issue where the Exalt Lock caused by Awakener "Tawil"'s Exalt "Omnifex Convergence" was being affected by Damage increase and decrease Effects.
○ Fixed an issue where the Wheel of Destiny "Kiss of Repose" would benefit from the wielder's Damage-boosting Effect bonuses again when transferring overflow Damage.

[General]
● General
○ Fixed an issue in the "Records" and "Tutorial" interfaces where some Affixes, after tapping for details, would snap back and prevent viewing.
● Awaken
○ Fixed an issue where abnormal gray blocks would appear when navigating from the Character Event Awakening "Astral Reaver" interface to the Awakener details of "Lotan: Cetarchon".
● Curriculum
○ Fixed an issue where item resources could be lost when opening "Curriculum" repeatedly.
● Supplies
○ Attempted to fix an issue where the "Obtain Items" pop-up was not displaying correctly in certain situations.
